title: Page 5
content_zh:
“二少——”
“大事你都处理得那么优，这一点小事你居然办不好！”掌尚仁摇摇头，啜饮咖啡。“唉，生死有命，富贵在天，左金，你就等着安息吧！”
第2章(2)
“二少，你一定要帮我想办法啊！”
掌尚仁一脸为难。“这难啊，名牌包要一、两百个，我马上能调给你，偏偏要什么手工包，我去哪里生？难不成叫家里的欧巴桑马上去缝一个出来？”
“啊！”左金指着前方。
“啊什么啊？别指望我，我哪会缝！”这个小子，给天借胆了。
“不是，二少，你……你后面……”
“见鬼了？”难道他身后有背后灵？
“那个客人的包包，应该就是手工包。”左金含着泪水，手指颤抖抖，喜出望外的道。
回头瞄了一眼。“看起来像是，而且挺新的。长发及腰，婀娜多姿，背影看起来很正。”
“呃？”明明是在看包包，二少究竟看到哪里去了？
“不要说我没有挺你，三万块，买下那个包包。”啜一口咖啡，掌尚仁爽快的下结论。
“是。”左金感激涕零，立即起身，走向背对他们而坐的女客人，以恭敬的能心度先鞠个躬，“小姐，你好，请问你……呃，小姐……”
没回应。
掌尚仁转过头，指着自己的耳朵给左金看，示意她塞了耳机，当然听不到。
难怪方才他们一直在谈论手工包的事，后头这个人都静悄悄的。
“小姐，这个……”
“小姐，你好……”
“小姐……”

掌尚仁两手环胸，坐在原位静观其变。只见那女生低着头不知究竟在忙什么，连左金站在她身边好一会儿都没发觉。
“小姐……”喊了好几声都没反应，左金投来求助的眼神。
掌尚仁做出拔掉耳机的动作，示意他照做。
“小姐……”左金犹豫了下，照着掌尚仁的指示，将女客人的耳机拔下。“小姐，不好意思，那个……”
耳机突然被拔掉，低头专心在做某件事的女客人吓一跳，不听左金想说什么，她凶巴巴地劈头就嚷——
“敢再动我的东西，你的手就会生疮流脓，泡到盐水，一辈子烂掉！”
吓！左金立刻缩回手，吓得狂退好几步。
掌尚仁则是瞬间呆掉。这……好耳熟的台词！
这段话，不就是巴瑞儿专门用来吼那些爱乱动她东西的男同学？很幸运的，他本人也曾被吼过，是以，依稀记得这段经典毒舌宝典里的台词之一。
但不会这么巧吧？今天他就这么三生有幸地，刚好遇到毒舌派掌门人巴瑞儿Z不，他不想这么幸运，真的，一点都不想！
看看咖啡店里的客人，每个人都是一副受到惊吓的表情就知道，此姝非善类，千万别靠近，能闪就闪！
“敢再动我的东西，你的手就会生疮流脓，泡到盐水，一辈子烂掉！”
说出这句话，巴瑞儿真想咬掉自己的舌头。
看看，她多么懂得吸引众人的目光，话，出，全咖啡店的客人皆对她行注目礼。
客人吓呆地望着她，她也僵呆地回望众人。
整间咖啡店室内气氛僵凝住……
话说，为何她会来到这里？
前天，她终于清楚自己想做的事是什么，花了一天又三个小时，她用身边唾手可得的材料——二姊寄放在她那儿的床罩，和一些不再穿又舍不得丢的衣服，拼拼凑凑，做了一个手工包。
做了一整天都未休息，虽然累，却很快乐。
妈妈是裁缝师，小时候家里总是有很多碎布，大姊手艺好，她会把很多碎布拼成一件好看的衣服或裙子；二姊是过动儿，她会把她和大姊好不容易集中起来的碎布，整堆捧起往空中洒，待她们抗议，她就会乖乖的把散落的碎布再集中起来，然后一个手痒，又捧起碎布往空中抛。

而她，手艺没大姊那么厉害，也不像二姊那么顽皮，但她会学大姊把碎布拼凑起来，做成提袋或小包包。
别人家的姊妹都在玩芭比娃娃，她们三姊妹的童年，都在碎布中度过，大姊帮很多同学的芭比娃娃做新衣裳，她则帮忙做芭比娃娃的小提包，也因此，她们姊妹赚了很多零用钱。
曾几何时，这项联系着母亲和她们三姊妹的手艺，被日后的求学、工作，推挤得销声匿迹，十多年，她未再拿过针线。
昨日重拾针线，童年的快乐和感动重回到她身上，让她更确定自己想做的工作——缝制手工包。
今早，和以前广告公司的同事和几名好友通过电话，同事和好友闻讯，不敢置信，还认为她疯了，但她很快乐，这是真的！
她去买了好多针线和一些小工具，经过这家咖啡店，想起自己好久没喝康宝蓝，为了庆祝自己的“新生”，遂进来点了杯康宝蓝犒赏自己，戴起小耳机，缝着小扣子，沉溺在手工的世界里，怎知——
都怪眼前这个没礼貌的男人，干么拿开她的耳机，害她很顺口的就说出那段话。
母亲临终前，最担心的就是她和二姊皆未找到终身伴侣。不时为爱疯狂的二姊要找伴侣不成问题，母亲最担心的其实是她，说她这张嘴若能忍一个月不出恶言，肯定有一牛车的男人排队等着娶她回家。
母亲在被病魔折腾之下，说出的玩笑话，其实带着满腹心酸。
为了不辜负母亲临终前的期许，她常告诫自己，无奈事与愿违，她总是在很自然的情况下溜出口之后，才想将恶言吞回，但已来不及。
微笑、微笑，再微笑——
端坐着，巴瑞儿对着店里的客人们扬起微笑，只差没友善的挥挥手。
但……唉，众目睽睽之下，扬高八度的咒骂，要再装出自己多有气质，鬼都不信！
“小姐，我没……没恶意。”趁某女露出友善的微笑，左金赶紧解释。“我只是想问你，你的包包在哪里买的？”
睨他一眼，一个陌生人，友善到令人发毛地步，肯定有鬼！
她懒洋洋道：“我的包包里，一毛钱都没有，不管你是想偷、想拐、要抢、要骗，我劝你不要浪费时间。”
“嗄？”说得他好像是诈骗集团派来的，左金下意识地望向掌尚仁求救。“不是的，小姐，你误会了，是我家二少……呃，总裁，他想买你的包包。”
平常左金仍是习惯称呼掌尚仁为二少或副总裁，现阶段，在外人面前，他则尊称掌尚仁为总裁。
看到左金指向他，掌尚仁急忙挥手想示意他不用介绍，但为时巳晚，当他猛挥手，笨蛋左金还不懂他的指示之际，背对着他的女生已转过头来。
“嗨，美女。”

尽管心中一千、一万个不想“重新”认识她，但不管什么情况之下，他都得展现掌家人的风度，是以，前一秒钟猛浑舞暗喻“不要”的手，此刻立即转变成友善的挥手招呼。
“你……掌尚仁！”看到坐在身后的人，竟然是日前被她催讨爱心债的债务人，这个巧遇，真令巴瑞儿吓凸了眼。
他清偿了爱心债之后，她以为这辈子，除非她特意去找他，否则他们两人不会再相遇，没想到……
“你……”哇，正妹！
圆圆的大眼睛，俏挺的鼻，小巧但还算有肉的粉唇，白嫩嫩的水肌，娇小玲珑的身材，配上长及腰的黑发，活脱脱像个洋娃娃——
“呃，你不认识我，不过我在杂志上看过你，所以认得你。”她自己也搞不懂为何要这么说，大概是某种“近朋情怯”的效应在心中作祟。
content_en:
"Second Young Master——"
"You handle big things so well, but you can't handle this little thing!" Zhang Shangren shook his head and sipped his coffee. "Oh, life and death are destiny, wealth is in heaven, Zuo Jin, just wait and rest!"
Chapter 2(2)
"Second Young Master, you must help me find a way!"
Zhang Shangren looked embarrassed. "It's difficult. You need one or two hundred brand-name bags. I can get them to you right away. But what kind of handmade bags do you want? Where should I go to make them? Is it possible to ask Obasan at home to sew one right away?"
"Ah!" Zuo Jin pointed forward.
"Ah what? Don't count on me, I can't sew!" This boy was so brave.
"No, Second Young Master, you... behind you..."
"What the hell?" Is there a spirit behind him?
"That customer's bag must be a handmade bag." Zuo Jin said with tears in his eyes, his fingers trembling, and he was overjoyed.
He glanced back. "It looks like it, and it's quite new. Her hair reaches her waist, she's graceful, and her back looks pretty straight."
"Huh?" He was obviously looking at the bag, but where did the second young master see it?
"Don't say I didn't support you, buy that bag for 30,000 yuan." Taking a sip of coffee, Zhang Shangren concluded quickly.
"Yes." Zuo Jin burst into tears with gratitude. He immediately stood up and walked towards the female guest who was sitting with her back to them. He bowed first with a respectful attitude, "Miss, hello, may I ask you... er, miss..."
No response.
Zhang Shangren turned his head, pointed to his ears and showed them to Zuo Jin, telling her to plug in her earphones, but of course she couldn't hear them.
No wonder they had been talking about handmade bags just now, and this person behind them was quiet.
"Miss, this..."
"Hello, Miss..."
"Miss..."
Zhang Shangren folded his hands around his chest and sat down to watch the changes. The girl lowered her head and didn't know what she was doing. She didn't even notice that Zuo Jin was standing next to her for a while.
"Miss..." After shouting several times, there was no response. Zuo Jin looked at her for help.
Zhang Shangren made a gesture of unplugging his earphones and signaled him to do so.
"Miss..." Zuo Jin hesitated, and followed Zhang Shangren's instructions to unplug the female guest's earphones. "Miss, I'm sorry, that..."
The earphones were suddenly unplugged, and the female guest, who was concentrating on something with her head down, was startled. Instead of listening to what Zuo Jin wanted to say, she shouted fiercely——
"If you dare to touch my things again, your hands will get sores and pus, soak in salt water, and rot for the rest of your life!"
Scared! Zuo Jin immediately retracted his hand and took several steps back in fear.
Zhang Shangren was stunned instantly. This... is such a familiar line!
Isn't this sentence specifically used by Barrier to yell at those male classmates who like to mess with her things? Fortunately, he himself had been yelled at before, so he vaguely remembered one of the lines from this classic book of poisonous tongues.
But it can't be such a coincidence, right? Today he was lucky enough to meet the leader of the Venomous Tongue Sect, Barrier Z. No, he didn't want to be so lucky, really, not at all!
Looking at the customers in the coffee shop, everyone has a frightened expression, and you know that this woman is not a kind person, so don't get close to her, just dodge if you can!
"If you dare to touch my things again, your hands will get sores and pus, soak in salt water, and rot for the rest of your life!"
Saying these words, Barrier really wanted to bite off her tongue.
Look, how well she knows how to attract everyone's attention. Every time she speaks, all the guests in the coffee shop pay attention to her.
The guests looked at her in shock, and she looked back at everyone in a daze.
The atmosphere inside the entire coffee shop was frozen...
By the way, why did she come here?
The day before yesterday, she finally knew what she wanted to do. She spent a day and three hours piecing together materials that were readily available around her - the bedspread that her second sister had left at her place, and some clothes that she no longer wore but couldn't bear to throw away, and made a handmade bag.
I worked all day without taking a break. Although I was tired, I was very happy.My mother is a seamstress, and there were always a lot of rags in the house when I was a child. The eldest sister is good at craftsmanship, and she will put many rags together into a beautiful dress or skirt. The second sister is hyperactive, and she will pick up the rags that she and the eldest sister have finally collected and throw them into the air. When they protest, she will obediently gather the scattered rags again, and then when her hands feel itchy, she will pick up the rags and throw them into the air.
As for her, she is not as good at crafts as her eldest sister, nor is she as naughty as her second sister, but she can learn from her eldest sister to piece together rags and make them into bags or small bags.
The other sisters all played with Barbie dolls, and the three sisters spent their childhoods playing with rags. The eldest sister helped make new clothes for many of her classmates' Barbie dolls, while she helped make Barbie dolls' handbags. As a result, the sisters earned a lot of pocket money.
Once upon a time, this craft that connected her mother and the three sisters was pushed out of existence by future studies and work. She has not picked up a needle and thread for more than ten years.
She picked up needlework again yesterday, and the joy and emotion of her childhood returned to her, making her more certain about the job she wanted to do - sewing handmade bags.
This morning, I had a phone call with colleagues and several friends from my former advertising agency. When my colleagues and friends heard the news, they couldn’t believe it and thought she was crazy, but she was very happy. It was true!
She went to buy a lot of needlework and some small tools. After passing this coffee shop, she remembered that she had not drank Herbalife for a long time. In order to celebrate her "rebirth", she went in and ordered a cup of Herbalife to reward herself. She put on small headphones, sewed small buttons, and indulged in the world of handicrafts. How could she know——
It was all her fault that the rude man in front of her took away her headphones and made her say that smoothly.
Before her death, her mother was most worried that neither she nor her second sister had found a lifelong partner. The second sister, who has always been crazy about love, has no problem finding a partner. The mother is actually worried about her most. She said that if she can hold her mouth without saying bad words for a month, there will definitely be a line of men waiting to marry her home.
The jokes my mother made when she was tortured by the illness were actually full of sadness.
In order to live up to her mother's wishes before she died, she often warned herself, but it backfired. She always slipped out of her mouth under natural circumstances and then tried to swallow the bad words back, but it was too late.
Smile, smile, smile again——
Sitting upright, Barrier raised a smile to the customers in the store, except for a friendly wave.
But... alas, in front of everyone, if you curse at the top of your voice, if you try to show off your temperament, no one will believe you!
"Miss, I don't...have any ill intentions." Zuo Jin quickly explained while a certain woman showed a friendly smile. "I just want to ask you, where did you buy your bag?"
Take a look at him, you will see that a stranger is so friendly that it is embarrassing, there must be something wrong with him!
She said lazily: "I don't have a dime in my bag. Whether you want to steal, abduct, rob, or deceive, I advise you not to waste your time."
"Huh?" It sounded like he was sent by a fraud group. Zuo Jin subconsciously looked to Zhang Shangren for help. "No, miss, you misunderstood. It's my second young master...er, the president. He wants to buy your bag."
Normally Zuo Jin is still used to calling Zhang Shangren the second young master or vice president. At this stage, in front of outsiders, he respectfully calls Zhang Shangren the president.
Seeing Zuo Jin pointing at him, Zhang Shangren waved hurriedly to indicate that he didn't need to introduce him, but it was too late. When he waved violently and the idiot Zuo Jin didn't understand his instructions, the girl with her back to him had already turned her head.
"Hi, beauty."
Although he didn't want to "get to know her again" in his heart, he had to show the demeanor of a family member no matter what the situation. Therefore, the hand that was waving violently as a metaphor for "no" one second immediately turned into a friendly wave at the moment.
"You... Zhang Shangren!" Seeing that the person sitting behind her turned out to be the debtor of love that she had recently collected.Man, this chance encounter really made Barry's eyes bulge with fright.
After he paid off his love debt, she thought that in this life, unless she went to find him specifically, the two of them would never meet again, but she didn't expect...
"You..." Wow, pretty girl!
Big round eyes, a pretty nose, small but still fleshy pink lips, white and tender skin, petite figure, and waist-length black hair, she looks like a doll——
"Well, you don't know me, but I've seen you in a magazine, so I recognize you." She herself didn't understand why she said this. It was probably some kind of "fear of close friends" effect in her heart.
